metadata.title: When your Jett thinks she’s a teleporting ninja but ends up stuck in the ceiling
metadata.description:
GanpatiGamerBoi's Jett tried to outplay everyone but gravity had other plans. 
Ever seen a ninja get caught mid-air? Now you have.
Click if you’ve ever misclicked your way into meme history!

Click now and laugh at my ninja skills... or lack thereof!
